circuits.issue: The drawn cable is 2.5 mm²; the specification requires a minimum 6 mm² copper cable.
The shower circuit is not shown with 30 mA RCD protection, which the specification requires.

sequence.action: Switch off the main switch, isolate the supply, apply lock-off and warning notices, and prove the voltage tester before and after proving the installation dead.

Inspect the design and installation provisions against the specification, identifying C1 and C2 as socket outlets, C3 and C4 as lighting, C5 as cooker, and C6 as shower. Confirm that C5 requires 6 mm² cable and C6 requires 30 mA RCD protection.

Install the final circuits to the corrected design. Use the drawn compliant arrangements for C1-C4, replace the C5 cable with at least 6 mm² copper, and provide 30 mA RCD protection for C6. Make all terminations, earthing and bonding connections, and circuit identification complete while the supply remains isolated.
Test and record continuity of protective conductors for C1.
Test and record continuity of protective conductors for C2.
Test and record continuity of protective conductors for C3.
Test and record continuity of protective conductors for C4.
Test and record continuity of protective conductors for C5.
Test and record continuity of protective conductors for C6.
Test and record insulation resistance for C1 with sensitive equipment disconnected as necessary.
Test and record insulation resistance for C2 with sensitive equipment disconnected as necessary.
Test and record insulation resistance for C3 with sensitive equipment disconnected as necessary.
Test and record insulation resistance for C4 with sensitive equipment disconnected as necessary.
Test and record insulation resistance for C5 with sensitive equipment disconnected as necessary.
Test and record insulation resistance for C6 with sensitive equipment disconnected as necessary.
Test and record polarity for C1.
Test and record polarity for C2.
Test and record polarity for C3.
Test and record polarity for C4.
Test and record polarity for C5.
Test and record polarity for C6.
After satisfactory dead-test results, remove test links as appropriate, refit covers, and energize the installation using the main switch.
Measure and record earth fault loop impedance for C1.
Measure and record earth fault loop impedance for C2.
Measure and record earth fault loop impedance for C3.
Measure and record earth fault loop impedance for C4.
Measure and record earth fault loop impedance for C5.
Measure and record earth fault loop impedance for C6.
Test and record operation of the 30 mA RCD protecting C1.
Test and record operation of the 30 mA RCD protecting C2.
Carry out the required RCD operation verification for C3's supply arrangement and record that no circuit-specific 30 mA RCD is required.
Carry out the required RCD operation verification for C4's supply arrangement and record that no circuit-specific 30 mA RCD is required.
Carry out the required RCD operation verification for C5's supply arrangement and record that no circuit-specific 30 mA RCD is required.
Test and record operation of the 30 mA RCD protecting C6.
Functionally test all outlets, switches and connected equipment on C1.
Functionally test all outlets, switches and connected equipment on C2.
Functionally test all switches and luminaires on C3.
Functionally test all switches and luminaires on C4.
Functionally test the cooker circuit and cooker connection on C5.
Functionally test the shower circuit and shower isolating/control equipment on C6.

Review all test results, rectify any failures, label the consumer unit and circuits, provide the installation and test records, explain operation and isolation to the user, and hand over the completed installation.
